intro.en: Find a cable model or material part number, then send it for a custom replacement or original-part sourcing review.
intro.zh: 按成品型号或材料料号查找，提交编号即可沟通兼容替代件制作或原厂件采购。

search_label.en: Find a model or part number

search_placeholder.en: Brand, model, part number or product type
search_placeholder.zh: 输入品牌、型号、料号或产品类型

empty.en: No matching references. Try a brand, full part number or a listed alias.
empty.zh: 未找到匹配项，请尝试品牌、完整料号或已列出的别名。

intro.en: Preassembled cables explicitly identified for robot connections.
intro.zh: 原厂明确用于机器人连接的预制电缆。

intro.en: Robot and torsion cable materials with specific manufacturer application evidence.
intro.zh: 具有原厂机器人或扭转工况依据的原线材料。

checks_title.en: Six Decisions Behind the Part Number
checks_title.zh: 型号背后的六个选型要点

copy.en: Confirm the robot or drive connection and the exact mating pin map.
copy.zh: 确认机器人或驱动连接接口及准确对插针脚。

copy.en: Distinguish robot-axis torsion from linear travel on an external axis.
copy.zh: 区分机器人轴的扭转运动与外部轴的直线往复。

copy.en: Define twist angle, free length, moving bend radius and the motion sequence.
copy.zh: 定义扭转角度、自由长度、动态弯曲半径及运动顺序。

copy.en: Set routing, clamp positions and clearance across the full movement envelope.
copy.zh: 按完整运动范围确定布线路径、固定位置与活动间隙。

copy.en: Review conductor size, pairs, shielding and separation between circuit types.
copy.zh: 核对线径、线对、屏蔽及不同回路类型的分隔。

copy.en: Agree prototype checks under the actual robot path and operating conditions.
copy.zh: 围绕实际机器人轨迹与运行条件约定样品验证。

boundary.en: Send the part number, drawing or sample to confirm the replacement configuration and sourcing plan.
boundary.zh: 请提供型号、图纸或样品，具体替代配置与原厂件采购方案按项目确认。

text.en: Send the model or part number to discuss your project.
text.zh: 提交型号或料号，沟通您的定制与采购需求。

reason.en: Manufacturer-verified robot cable references are shown at their actual audited count; raw cable is counted as material only. This verified subset does not yet meet the target of 200 finished models and 200 material part numbers.
reason.zh: 机器人专用电缆按原厂可核验的实际数量展示，裸缆只计入材料。 此处为已核验子集，200个成品型号和200个材料料号的目标仍待补充。
